experts.label: Skateboard

schema.input: 395D block-major five-frame actual proprioception/executed-action history, requested speed/absolute heading, 6s clock
schema.output: third released actor hidden layer after ELU
schema.reference: constant HUSKY initial joint posture plus requested planar velocity; no teacher future trajectory

evidence_notes: Teacher seeds 9101/9102; student seeds 10101/10102, with one straight and one turning command. Different seeds prevent episode-by-episode pairing.
Starts on the board; autonomous mounting was not evaluated. The 128-dimensional context comes from the frozen HUSKY proprioceptive hidden layer, not a visual encoder.
Greater displacement does not imply more accurate velocity or turning tracking.

experts.label: Tennis return
evidence_notes: 16 matched-seed, 40-second episodes with 8 complete incoming balls each. The 128 balls are not 128 independent robot episodes.
The student executes zero teacher-action steps. Inputs are ball state and native observations, not camera pixels.
Uses native ATHLETE G1 physics and motors; this is not cross-robot validation on the canonical HoloMotion hardware configuration.
The improvement from the earlier 35k student to the selected 44k student reflects this training process; it does not establish a causal benefit of a pretrained over a random base.

experts.label: Roundhouse kick
evidence_notes: The roundhouse expert uses PPO with a motion reference, without a distilled policy teacher. A kinematic reference is not a physical teacher.
The 31-task roster points to continuation_250/model_499, whereas the existing report selects continuation_100/model_349. This comparison uses the reported selection and does not mix them.
The model_840 kick with competitive routing belongs to a separate experiment and is excluded from the historical 31-task teacher-student table with continuous mixing.

experts.label: Commanded walking
evidence_notes: The teacher uses 8 environments at seed 7002; the student uses 16 environments at seeds 8101/8102. This is a distributional comparison across different seeds.
Full-sequence survival and batch-level tracking/stopping acceptance are reported separately. Batch acceptance is not treated as independent per-environment tracking success.
Inputs are proprioceptive state and velocity commands, without camera pixels. The navigation demonstration additionally uses simulation localization.

experts.label: Stair ascent

schema.reference: constant native standing posture and measured pelvis pose integrated by current requested velocity; no motion-file future

evidence_notes: The teacher gate result of 6/8 and student result of 16/16 use different seeds. Before refinement, the student scored 13/16 on the same 16 seeds. These are separate comparisons.
Teacher and student use different seeds. A distributional comparison on the same task and scene does not establish episode-by-episode wins.
Reset, goal generation and termination rules evolved between versions. Only the teacher corresponding to the final training version is used; earlier failed teachers are not substituted.
Goal dwell and physical validity must be checked for each task. A timeout or completion of the reference alone does not count as success.

experts.label: Terrain dance
evidence_notes: The PMT teacher was locally adapted to the canonical HoloMotion motors; it is not the unmodified official checkpoint.
Teacher seeds 7002/7003; selected student seeds 7602/7603. The selected student scores 16/16 versus 11/16 for an earlier student, not versus the teacher.
Both the actor and reward use the official optimized placement0 reference. This does not show that raw walking visually adapts to arbitrary terrain.
The teacher visual component is frozen, but student context also contains observation-bridge information. The necessity of vision has not been ablated.

experts.label: Box carrying
evidence_notes: The 512 environments have identical, deterministic initial states. These are repeated checks under one condition, not 512 independent trials.
Physical carrying and reference completion are scored separately. The public base survives and finishes the reference in 512/512 cases, but physically carries the box in 0/512.
The student does not exceed the teacher carrying rate. Differences in lift height, translation and contact time do not define a single quality ranking.
Uses the native ULTRA robot and actuators; this is not transfer validation on the canonical HoloMotion motor configuration.

experts.label: Forward roll
evidence_notes: The same native MuJoCo-Warp task and reference are evaluated at seeds 7002 and 7003 with 8 environments each. Without per-environment initial-state hashes, matching seeds do not prove elementwise identical initial states.
Endpoint error includes failed episodes. Root error is averaged over surviving environments at each time, rather than over jointly surviving frames.
Completing the reference does not automatically establish geometric-goal completion. Data cover only the fixed published tasks.
